summary: Postinstall dropper fetches and executes obfuscated remote binary
details: beaver-ui-grid@12.7.3 advertises a UI grid component but ships a setup.js triggered from postinstall (and from require via index.js) that assembles Cloudflare Workers hostnames by string-splitting (oob-worker.cf99-9b3.workers.dev, cf100-416/cf101-adf/cf102-baf/cf103-070.workers.dev) with a DNS TXT fallback channel over tin/tina/ldr/win.dl.well1.site, downloads a platform-specific binary via https.get, writes it to /var/tmp or %TEMP% under a disguised name such as dotnet_diag_<hex>.exe or.cache_<hex>, chmods 0755 on Unix, and launches it detached and unref'd. setup.js also invokes execSync('powershell...') on Windows. The DNS TXT fallback reads a chunk count from c.<domain> and concatenates base64 chunks from <i>.<domain>. The package's minimal UI class is a cover for install-time delivery and execution of attacker-controlled code on the installer's machine.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
